title: Free Doughnuts and a Five-Block Experiment: Rappi's Start in Bogotá
conflicts: Funding timing: LAVCA (Dec 2016) says US$9m+ raised in April 2016, iProUP (citing Crunchbase) says November 2016; YC entry dated February 2016 by MIT Technology Review while Borrero puts friends-and-family money in February and the seed after YC: story says only '2016'. User counts and growth rates differ between LAVCA and MIT Technology Review, so none used. Beta Boom says founded in Cali; all others and Borrero say Bogotá: used Bogotá. iProUP names a fourth founder (Juan Pablo Ortega), consistent with Borrero's 'four guys'; story keeps the three slate founders and quotes 'four guys'.
notes: Main founder sources are the 2016 LAVCA interview and founder quotes in iProUP (2020); the Y Combinator statement is quoted via Beta Boom because the YC page needs JavaScript. Spanish founder quotes are paraphrased, not quoted. Ends with a brief, neutral note on the courier employment-status disputes.
